ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.65 ratio of high-intensity pixels (white field) to low-intensity pixels (dark regions) across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white zones occupy the distal two-thirds of both lobes. A central, low-intensity black wedge originates from the peduncle and tapers toward the median notch. High-frequency, low-intensity pixel mottling is dense across the interior white regions, particularly on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 52 degrees and a bounding-box depth of roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with 6-8 distinct peaks on the left lobe trailing edge and 5-7 on the right lobe; average peak-to-valley amplitude is approximately 3-5 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep along the trailing edges, transitioning to a posterior-oriented curve at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, dark circular pixel clusters (3-5 pixel diameter) scattered on the white field of the right lobe, likely indicative of barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four distinct, parallel, low-intensity linear pixel chains (rake marks) oriented at a ~40-degree angle on the white surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible rake mark scarring on the left lobe; irregular, non-symmetrical pixel boundary at the far left tip suggests a minor tissue loss or deformity.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast black 'island' markings within the distal white zones, specifically near the posterior-lateral edge of the right lobe.
